name: Blob Size Policy

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/rust-ci.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/rust-release.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-setup-zig-pinning:
    name: Check setup-zig pinning
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify setup-zig is pinned to SHA
        run: |
          set -e
          
          TARGET_SHA="d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29"
          WORKFLOW_FILES=(
            ".github/workflows/rust-ci.yml"
            ".github/workflows/rust-release.yml"
            ".github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml"
          )
          
          for file in "${WORKFLOW_FILES[@]}"; do
            if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
              echo "::error::File $file not found"
              exit 1
            fi
            
            # Check if the file contains the setup-zig action
            if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig" "$file"; then
              # Check if it is pinned to the correct SHA
              if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@${TARGET_SHA}" "$file"; then
                echo "::notice::File $file correctly pins setup-zig to SHA ${TARGET_SHA}"
              else
                echo "::error::File $file does not pin setup-zig to the expected SHA ${TARGET_SHA}"
                echo "Current usage:"
                grep "mlugg/setup-zig" "$file"
                exit 1
              fi
            else
              echo "::notice::File $file does not use setup-zig, skipping"
            fi
          done
          
          echo "All checked workflow files correctly pin setup-zig to SHA ${TARGET_SHA}"
